LanguageData.LP_StormSinging.stages.0.label: the storm is singing
LanguageData.LP_StormSinging.stages.0.description: Raindrops on my face, thunder rolling in the clouds. This is the song of the deep sea, and I understand it.
LanguageData.LP_StormForeboding.stages.0.label: heavy portents
LanguageData.LP_StormForeboding.stages.0.description: I've seen things that haven't happened yet and can't pretend not to know. Only in the sound of rain, or alone, does my heart calm for a while.
